fields.label: Department
fields.note: Populated from the board data into select#departments-select[name=departments-select]; local.

notes: gravitonresearch.com/careers redirects to gravitontrading.com/careers, which embeds a local Greenhouse board: an iframe page (greenhouse-embed-local.html) rendering data/greenhouse_jobs.json, with board.filters.include_department_filter and include_office_filter true. The only controls are select#departments-select and select#offices-select (both client-side); the embed page has no keyword input, so keyword search is unsupported. Scraper reads the JSON board and filters locally.
evidence: https://www.gravitontrading.com/data/greenhouse_jobs.json (board.filters include_department_filter/include_office_filter true; department and office id maps)
